title: Foundations: layout and icons
goal: Layout helpers and an icon approach
acceptance: Layout classes on the spacing scale (bx-stack, bx-cluster, bx-grid, bx-columns, bx-safe-area, bx-gap-n), breakpoints (BREAKPOINTS sm 480, md 768, lg 1024) and safe-area tokens (--bx-safe-*)
Icon approach decided: a small inline SVG set (foundations/icons.ts) in currentColor, no icon font or CDN, with one icon component (bx-icon) that is decorative or labelled
In the catalogue in all three themes with axe passing; unit and browser tests written first
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-25 in one PR; verification is its CI. No actual: the step's start time was not recorded.
